title: Clarify that USR1 only reopens the access log file
body:
### What does this PR do?

This PR clarifies the log rotation documentation: the USR1 signal only reopens the access log file, and the Traefik log file rotates with the `log.maxSize`, `log.maxAge`, and `log.maxBackups` options.

### Motivation

The documentation says that Traefik reopens its log files on USR1, but the Traefik log file is not reopened.
Related to #11342.

### More

- [ ] Added/updated tests
- [x] Added/updated documentation

### Additional Notes

Assisted-by: Claude
